description: A React component for managing throughput equations and scalars in an asset details page. Provides CRUD operations, data loading, and UI for creating, editing, and listing throughput setup parameters.

methods.name: buildEquationIndex
methods.description: Creates a Map index of EquationMasterDto objects keyed by their equationMasterId for quick lookup.

methods.name: buildUomIndex
methods.description: Creates a Map index of UomMasterDto objects keyed by their uomId for quick lookup.

methods.name: reloadEquations
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the list of throughput equations for the current asset and input parameter.

methods.name: openCreateEquation
methods.description: Prepares the form state for creating a new throughput equation and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEditEquation
methods.description: Prepares the form state with data from an existing equation for editing.

methods.name: saveEquation
methods.description: Validates and submits the throughput equation form for creating or updating a throughput equation.

methods.name: openScalars
methods.description: Loads and displays the scalars associated with a throughput equation.

methods.name: openCreateScalar
methods.description: Resets the scalar form for creating a new scalar and opens the scalar modal.

methods.name: openEditScalar
methods.description: Loads scalar data into form for editing.

methods.name: saveScalar
methods.description: Validates and submits the scalar form for creating or updating a throughput scalar.
